basis: Supplied six-package text brief; no inaccessible linked sandbox document is inferred.

packages.title: Better summaries and exact predicate-exclusion reuse
Changed-generation preparation reuse and safe publication

new_steps.label: Conditional investigation: measure repeated codec setup, then reuse immutable preparation or exclusively leased mutable workspaces through the existing shared owner. Separate recipe identity from data-derived generation identity; include reset, concurrency, reclaim, first-use/later-use costs and portable fresh-process decoding. Follow [CPU package B](native-cpu-investigations-2026-10-18.md#b--reusable-codec-preparation); cross-operation admission belongs with PERF-02.physical_cache.

Conditional investigation: find a production selection/descriptor expansion cost, then preserve compact membership or ordered-gather representations through real count and projection consumers. Preserve duplicate/order semantics, checked wide global positions, sliced bases, validity and retained owners; charge construction/conversion/iteration and complete-operation cost. Follow [CPU package A](native-cpu-investigations-2026-10-18.md#a--compact-selections-and-execution-descriptors).

Conditional investigation: reuse exact whole-region evidence that a fully identified predicate has no TRUE result across related operations. Bind complete coverage, immutable region/source, expression/type/NULL/collation/timezone/deletion/access semantics; reject partial/cancelled/failed observations and unsafe negation. Measure construction, use and invalidation separately from first-use summaries under [CPU package D](native-cpu-investigations-2026-10-18.md#d--first-use-summaries-and-exact-predicate-exclusion-reuse).

Conditional investigation: test a small deterministic reversible representation for original payload structure, with literal residuals/exceptions and exact validity. Preserve logical types and bytes, useful native consumers and producer-close/move/fresh-process-reopen/write/reopen behavior; include complete artifact and workflow costs. Follow [CPU package C](native-cpu-investigations-2026-10-18.md#c--reversible-structural-payload-encoding), distinct from derived columns and rejected codec-profile sweeps.

extended_step_suffixes.PERF-06.membership: Apply [CPU package E](native-cpu-investigations-2026-10-18.md#e--partition-major-external-memory-state): partition-major finalization/release, full ordinals and multiplicity, original-position masks, exact population/sampling semantics and skew progress through native runs. Capability completion is independent of a Full43 speed threshold.
extended_step_suffixes.PERF-07.publication: Apply [CPU package F](native-cpu-investigations-2026-10-18.md#f--changed-generation-reuse-and-safe-publication): real writer coordination and one authoritative managed-generation transition, stable readers, ambiguous-commit retry, separate visibility/durability and reader-safe cleanup. Safe replacement remains required if reuse is dropped.
extended_step_suffixes.PERF-10.summaries: Apply [CPU package D](native-cpu-investigations-2026-10-18.md#d--first-use-summaries-and-exact-predicate-exclusion-reuse): earn creation/storage/read cost on first use and describe the actual transformed output; recurring exclusion facts have a separate conditional step.
extended_step_suffixes.PERF-02.changed_source: Apply [CPU package F](native-cpu-investigations-2026-10-18.md#f--changed-generation-reuse-and-safe-publication): trustworthy immutable file/region identity, schema/transform/recipe/dictionary/deletion compatibility and complete refresh-versus-rebuild validation/copy/metadata costs; path/length/mtime alone are insufficient.

execution_sequence: Short A/B production-cost assessment, then strongest actual opportunity; actual dependencies only. E and safe publication in F remain required capability work.
